item.title: White House Shows Signs of Preparing for U.S.-North Korea Summit... Inquiry to Remains Recovery Agency "Similar to 2018" (백악관, 미·북회담 준비 정황… 유해 발굴 기관에 문의 “2018년과 비슷”)
item.description:
White House Shows Signs of Preparing for U.S.-North Korea Summit... Inquiry to Remains Recovery Agency "Similar to 2018" (백악관, 미·북회담 준비 정황… 유해 발굴 기관에 문의 “2018년과 비슷”)

With U.S. President Donald Trump expressing his willingness to engage in dialogue with North Korea's Kim Jong-un, signs have emerged that the White House is making administrative preparations for a U.S.-North Korea summit. Kelly McKeague, director of the Defense POW/MIA Accounting Agency (DPAA) under the U.S. Department of Defense, said on the 31st during a virtual discussion hosted by the Washington, D.C.-based non-governmental organization National Committee on North Korea (NCNK) that he received a White House inquiry asking what the DPAA could do if Trump reached an agreement with Kim Jong-un, to which he responded, "We are ready to cooperate with North Korea." The DPAA is responsible for searching for and recovering U.S. military remains, identifying them, and confirming their repatriation. (도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 북한 김정은과의 대화 의지를 밝힌 가운데, 백악관이 미·북 회담을 위한 행정부 차원의 준비를 하고 있는 정황이 포착됐다. 미 전쟁부(국방부) 산하 전쟁포로·실종자 확인국(DPAA)의 켈리 맥케이그 국장은 31일 워싱턴 DC의 민간 단체 전미북한위원회(NCNK)가 주최한 화상 대담에서 트럼프가 김정은과 합의할 경우 DPAA가 어떤 조처를 할 수 있는지를 묻는 백악관 질의를 받아 “우리는 북한과 협력할 준비가 돼 있다”고 답했다고 밝혔다. DPAA는 미군 유해 수색·발굴, 신원 확인, 유해 봉환 확인 업무 등을 담당한다.)

McKeague said, "I would say it's no different from the situation before and after the 2018 Singapore U.S.-North Korea summit," adding, "We were asked again, from the perspective of realistic possibilities, what the agency could do if the president reaches an agreement with the North Korean leader." According to McKeague, he told the White House that the agency was prepared to cooperate with North Korea to recover the remains of U.S. soldiers killed in action or taken prisoner during the Korean War. "First, it would help if North Korea handed over the remains it possesses to the U.S., and second, it would help to resume joint search operations, which were last conducted in 2005," he reportedly explained. The U.S. and North Korea conducted 37 joint remains recovery operations in North Korea from 1996 to 2005, identifying the remains of 153 U.S. soldiers. (맥케이그는 “2018년 싱가포르 미·북 회담을 앞뒀을 때 상황과 다르지 않다고 말하고 싶다”며 “우리는 대통령이 북한 지도자와 합의에 도달할 수 있다면 현실적 가능성의 관점에서 볼 때 (기관이) 무얼 할 수 있을지 다시 한번 질문을 받았다”고 했다. 맥케이그는 백악관 질의에 6·25 전쟁 도중 전사하거나 포로가 된 미군의 유해 수습을 위해 북한과 협력할 준비가 돼 있다고 답했다고 한다. “첫째로 북한이 보유한 유해를 (미국에) 인도하는 것이 도움이 될 것이고, 둘째로 2005년 마지막으로 진행된 합동 수색 활동을 재개하는 것이 도움이 될 것으로 설명했다”고 한다. 미국과 북한은 1996년부터 2005년까지 북한에서 37차례 공동 유해 발굴 작업을 진행해 미군 153명의 신원을 밝혀냈다.)

McKeague noted that North Korea is familiar with joint remains recovery operations and knows the procedures well, saying, "We proposed deploying two recovery teams—one in Unsan and the other in the Chosin Reservoir area—for four 45-day operations per year." During the 2018 Singapore summit, cooperation on remains recovery was also addressed, but subsequent U.S.-North Korea tensions stalled progress. McKeague did not specify the exact timing of the White House inquiry, but it likely occurred after Trump sent a message of dialogue to Kim Jong-un. The White House's inquiry is interpreted as suggesting that Trump is hinting at a fourth meeting with Kim Jong-un. However, despite Trump's order to significantly reduce joint military exercises, opinions among foreign policy and security experts are divided on whether Kim Jong-un will come to the negotiating table. McKeague said, "As the president has publicly stated there is an opportunity to meet, we remain hopeful," adding, "Above all, I want to view this mission as a humanitarian one." (맥케이그는 북한이 공동 유해 발굴 작업에 익숙하고 방식을 잘 알고 있다며 “2개 발굴팀을 하나는 운산, 다른 하나는 장진에 투입해 연간 4차례 45일씩 활동하는 방식을 제안했다”고 말했다. 2018년 싱가포르 회담 때도 유해 발굴을 위한 협력 문제가 다뤄졌지만 이후 미·북 관계 경색으로 별다른 진전이 없었다. 맥케이그가 백악관 문의 시점을 구체적으로 밝히지는 않았지만, 트럼프가 김정은을 향해 대화 메시지를 발신한 이후 이뤄졌을 가능성이 있다. 백악관이 이런 질의를 한 것은 트럼프가 김정은과의 네 번째 만남을 시사한 것으로 풀이된다. 다만 트럼프가 연합 훈련 대폭 축소를 지시했음에도 김정은이 대화 테이블에 나올지는 외교·안보 전문가마다 관측이 엇갈리고 있다. 맥케이그는 “대통령이 공개적으로 만날 기회가 있다고 밝힌 만큼 우리는 희망을 품고 있다”며 “특히 이 임무를 무엇보다 인도주의 차원으로 생각하고 싶다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Government dispatches emergency relief team to Nepal via military transport plane... search and rescue for missing persons (정부, 네팔에 군 수송기로 긴급구호대 파견... 실종자 수색·구조)
item.description:
Government dispatches emergency relief team to Nepal via military transport plane... search and rescue for missing persons (정부, 네팔에 군 수송기로 긴급구호대 파견... 실종자 수색·구조)

The government will dispatch a Korea Disaster Relief Team (KDRT) of about 40 members to flood-affected areas in Nepal on the 1st. The overseas emergency relief team carries out activities to support affected countries in the event of large-scale overseas disasters, including disaster relief, life-saving operations, and medical assistance. (정부는 1일 네팔 홍수 피해 지역에 40여 명 규모의 해외긴급구호대(KDRT)를 파견한다. 해외긴급구호대는 대규모 해외 재난 발생 시 재난 구호, 인명 구조, 의료 구호 등 피해국을 지원하는 활동을 한다.)

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced that it had decided to dispatch the overseas emergency relief team to Nepal following a resolution by the "Public-Private Joint Overseas Emergency Relief Council" on the same day. (외교부는 이날 ‘민관합동 해외긴급구호협의회’ 의결을 거쳐 네팔에 해외긴급구호대 파견을 결정했다고 밝혔다.)

The emergency relief team, led by Lee Kyu-ho, Director-General of the Development Cooperation Bureau at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, consists of 44 members from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Korea International Cooperation Agency (KOICA), and the National Fire Agency, among others. The team is scheduled to depart for Nepal on a military transport plane tonight. (이규호 외교부 개발협력국장을 구호대장으로 하는 긴급구호대는 외교부, 한국국제협력단(KOICA), 소방청 등 44명으로 구성된다. 이날 밤 우리 군 수송기를 통해 네팔로 출국할 계획이다.)

This follows a request from the Nepalese government for the dispatch of an emergency relief team to support search and rescue operations in the affected areas, as flood damage in Nepal's Rasuwa district, which occurred on the 26th of last month, continues to escalate. (이는 지난달 26일 네팔 라수와(Rasuwa) 지역에서 발생한 홍수 피해가 커지는 가운데 네팔 정부가 우리 측에 피해 지역 수색·구조 활동 지원을 위한 긴급구호대 파견을 요청한 데 따른 것이다.)

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated, "Over an approximately 10-day schedule, the emergency relief team will closely communicate and cooperate with the Nepalese government on the ground to carry out search and rescue operations for victims, including our nationals who have lost contact." (외교부는 “긴급구호대는 약 10일간의 일정으로 현지에서 네팔 정부와 긴밀히 소통·협력하며 연락이 닿지 않는 우리 국민을 포함한 피해자 수색·구조 활동을 수행할 예정”이라고 했다.)

Previously, emergency relief teams were also dispatched following the 2023 earthquake in Türkiye, the 2018 dam collapse in Laos, and the 2015 earthquake in Nepal. (앞서 2023년 튀르키예 지진, 2018년 라오스 댐 붕괴, 2015년 네팔 지진 때도 긴급구호대가 파견됐다.)

On the 27th of last month, the government decided to provide $1 million in humanitarian assistance through international organizations active in the region to support response efforts for the floods in Nepal. (정부는 지난달 27일에는 네팔 홍수에 대응 지원을 위해 현지 활동 국제기구를 통한 100만달러 규모의 인도적 지원을 결정했다.)

item.title: Choi Min-hee: "Candidate Yong Hye-in Twice a Proportional Rep, That Shows She Has Talent" (최민희 “용혜인 후보 비례 두번, 그만큼 실력 있단 뜻”)
item.description:
Choi Min-hee: "Candidate Yong Hye-in Twice a Proportional Rep, That Shows She Has Talent" (최민희 “용혜인 후보 비례 두번, 그만큼 실력 있단 뜻”)

Choi Min-hee, a supreme council member of the Democratic Party of Korea, said on the 1st that regarding Yong Hye-in, the nominee for Minister of Gender Equality and Family, having served twice as a proportional representative lawmaker, "Being a proportional representative twice shows that she has that much ability." (최민희 더불어민주당 최고위원이 용혜인 성평등가족부장관 후보자가 비례의원만 2번 지낸 것에 대해 “비례대표 두 번 할 정도로 실력이 있는 것”이라고 1일 말했다.)

Choi responded this way on SBS Radio that day when asked about Yong's consecutive elections as a proportional representative. She also said, "That is pointing out the negative side for the sake of criticizing," and added, "A proportional representative stepping down from that role to take a ministerial position is not a legal constraint." She further stated, "I hope this is evaluated in a balanced way." (최 최고위원은 이날 SBS 라디오에서 연속 비례대표 당선에 대한 질문에 이 같이 답했다. 또 그는 “그거는 비난하기 위해서 비난할 때 안 좋은 측면을 말씀하시는 것이다”라며 “비례대표가 비례를 사퇴하고 장관직으로 가는 건 법적인 구속사항이 아니다”라고 했다. 또 “이게 균형 있게 평가되기를 바란다”라고 했다.)

She also emphasized that Minister nominee Yong should undergo public evaluation through the confirmation hearing process. Choi said, "There will be a hearing soon, and I think it's not too late for the public to listen to the explanations of nominee Yong Hye-in and then make their judgment." (그러면서 용 장관 후보자는 인사청문회 과정을 통해 국민적 평가를 받아야 한다고 강조했다. 최 최고위원은 “곧 청문회가 있을 것이고, 그때 국민들께서 용혜인 내정자의 해명을 들어보시고 판단하셔도 늦지 않다라고 생각한다”라고 했다.)

She also viewed Yong's appointment positively in terms of placing female talent in key roles within the broader cabinet reshuffle. Choi assessed, "Selecting Yong Hye-in, a 36-year-old working mother and former lawmaker, for the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family is positive in that it represents the advancement of female talent into important positions." (개각 전반에 대한 여성 인재 기용 측면에서도 용 내정자의 발탁을 긍정적으로 바라봤다. 최 최고위원은 “36세의 워킹맘 용혜인 전 의원을 성평등가족부에 발탁한 것도 여성인재의 중요 자리에 진출이라는 측면에서 긍정적으로 본다”라고 평가했다.)

item.title: Cho Kuk: "When President Lee's Term Ends and the Appeals Trial Resumes, Likelihood of Guilty Verdict Is Very High" (조국 “李 대통령 임기 후 재개될 2심, 유죄 가능성 매우 높다”)
item.description:
Cho Kuk: "When President Lee's Term Ends and the Appeals Trial Resumes, Likelihood of Guilty Verdict Is Very High" (조국 “李 대통령 임기 후 재개될 2심, 유죄 가능성 매우 높다”)

Cho Kuk, director of the Innovation Policy Research Institute of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, said on the 1st regarding President Lee Jae-myung's violation of the Public Official Election Act case, "Unless the Supreme Court's legal principles are overturned again, there is a very high likelihood of a guilty verdict in the appeals trial that will resume after President Lee's term ends." Regarding the Democratic Party of Korea's push to withdraw the indictment in cases related to President Lee, he warned, "They could face political and legal setbacks." (조국 조국혁신당 혁신정책연구원장이 1일 이재명 대통령의 공직선거법 위반 사건에 대해 “대법원의 법리가 다시 뒤집어지지 않는 한, 이 대통령 임기 후 재개될 2심 재판에서 유죄 판결이 내려질 가능성이 매우 높다”고 했다. 이 대통령 관련 사건의 공소 취소를 추진하는 더불어민주당을 향해서는 “정치적, 법적으로 낭패를 볼 수 있다”고 했다.)

Director Cho made these remarks in a Facebook post that day, referencing the so-called "Yoon Suk Yeol administration's fabricated indictment special counsel law" that the Democratic Party is pursuing and the issue of withdrawing the indictment. He said, "The Democratic Party welcomed the guilty verdict on Yoon Suk Yeol's crime of publishing false facts under the Public Official Election Act," adding, "But this ruling was faithfully rendered in accordance with the Supreme Court's remand legal principles affirming guilt regarding then-candidate Lee Jae-myung." (조 원장은 이날 페이스북에 글을 올려 민주당이 추진 중인 이른바 ‘윤석열 정권 조작기소 특검법’과 공소 취소 문제를 언급하며 이같이 밝혔다. 그는 “민주당은 윤석열의 공직선거법상 허위사실 공표죄 유죄 판결에 환영했다”며 “그런데 이 판결은 이재명 당시 후보에 대한 대법원의 유죄 취지 파기환송 법리에 충실하게 내려졌다”고 했다.)

In May of last year, the Supreme Court's en banc panel overturned the appellate court's acquittal in President Lee's case involving violations of the Public Official Election Act and remanded the case to the Seoul High Court with instructions to find him guilty. The case centered on whether statements made by Lee constituted publishing false facts: during the 2021 presidential election, he claimed that a photo showing him golfing with the late Kim Moon-ki, former head of the Seongnam Development Corporation, had been manipulated, and during a parliamentary audit, he threatened that if the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport did not respond to the change in zoning for the Baekhyeon-dong site, he would raise the issue as dereliction of duty. (대법원 전원합의체는 지난해 5월 이 대통령의 공직선거법 위반 사건에서 무죄를 선고한 항소심을 깨고 유죄 취지로 사건을 서울고법에 돌려보냈다. 이 사건은 이 대통령이 2021년 대선을 앞두고 고(故) 김문기 전 성남도시개발공사 처장과의 관계를 설명하는 과정에서 함께 골프를 친 사진이 조작됐다는 취지로 말하고, 국정감사에서 백현동 부지 용도변경과 관련해 국토교통부가 응하지 않으면 직무유기로 문제 삼겠다고 협박했다고 발언한 것이 허위사실 공표에 해당하는지가 쟁점이었다.)

Among these, the Supreme Court determined that the so-called "Kim Moon-ki golf remarks" and the "Baekhyeon-dong remarks" constituted publishing false facts. After President Lee took office, the Seoul High Court decided to schedule the remand trial at a later date, citing Article 84 of the Constitution. (대법원은 이 가운데 이른바 ‘김문기 골프 발언’과 ‘백현동 발언’을 허위사실 공표로 판단했다. 이후 이 대통령이 취임하자 서울고법은 헌법 84조를 근거로 파기환송심 기일을 추후 지정하기로 했다.)

Director Cho also raised issues with the Democratic Party's method of pursuing the indictment withdrawal. He said, "To withdraw an indictment on the grounds of a 'fabricated indictment,' the 'fabrication' must first be confirmed," and "Evidence of 'fabrication' must be secured through inspections by the Ministry of Justice and the Supreme Prosecutors' Office of the prosecutors in question, or through an investigation by the Corruption Investigation Office for High-ranking Officials." He added that since the Ministry of Justice's Prosecutorial Human Rights and Future Committee has decided to investigate the truth behind cases related to President Lee, such as the Daejang-dong and North Korea remittance cases, its findings should also be reviewed. (조 원장은 민주당의 공소 취소 추진 방식에도 문제를 제기했다. 그는 “‘조작기소’를 이유로 공소 취소를 하려면 ‘조작기소’가 확인돼야 한다”며 “문제 검사에 대한 법무부·대검찰청 차원의 감찰이나 고위공직자범죄수사처 수사를 통해 ‘조작’ 증거를 확보해야 한다”고 했다. 법무부 검찰인권존중미래위원회가 대장동·대북송금 등 이 대통령 관련 사건의 진상을 조사하기로 한 만큼 그 결과도 확인해야 한다고 했다.)

Under Article 255 of the current Criminal Procedure Act, withdrawal of an indictment is permitted only "before a judgment is rendered in the first instance trial." Citing this, Director Cho argued that "cases currently in the appeals stage cannot have their indictments withdrawn," and that if provisions allowing for withdrawal of indictments in President Lee's pending appellate cases were inserted into the special counsel law, it could spark constitutional controversy. (현행 형사소송법 255조는 공소 취소를 ‘제1심 판결 선고 전’까지만 할 수 있도록 하고 있다. 조 원장은 이를 들어 “2심이 진행 중인 사건은 공소 취소가 불가능하다”며 이 대통령의 항소심 계류 사건까지 공소를 취소할 수 있도록 특검법에 조항을 넣을 경우 위헌 논란이 생길 수 있다고 주장했다.)

Director Cho also criticized the way the Democratic Party has linked the indictment withdrawal push to President Lee's cases. He said, "The abuse of authority by Yoon Suk Yeol's prosecution was not limited to President Lee Jae-myung," and "If a law gives the impression that it was created for a specific individual, it will fail." He continued, "Cases eligible for indictment withdrawal at the first-instance stage and cases that must face trial after the president's term ends should be clearly distinguished and handled accordingly." (조 원장은 민주당이 공소 취소를 이 대통령 사건과 연결해 추진해 온 방식도 비판했다. 그는 “윤석열 검찰의 권한 남용은 이재명 대통령에 한정되지 않았다”며 “어떤 법률이 특정 개인만을 위해 만들어진다는 인상을 주면 실패한다”고 했다. 이어 “1심에서 공소 취소할 사건과 대통령 임기 종료 후 재판을 받아야 할 사건을 정확히 구분하고 조치해야 한다”고 했다.)

Last April, the Democratic Party proposed a special counsel law to investigate whether there was any fabrication in the prosecution's investigation and indictment processes during the Yoon Suk Yeol administration, including in the Daejang-dong and Ssangbangwool North Korea remittance cases. The bill includes provisions allowing the special counsel to request the transfer of related cases and to weigh in on whether to maintain indictments, and recently there have been calls within the Democratic Party to include authority to withdraw indictments as well. However, there are also voices within the party arguing that the power to withdraw indictments should be excluded from the special counsel law. The People Power Party is resisting, calling it a "special counsel for indictment withdrawal," arguing that the fabricated-indictment special counsel is ultimately aimed at withdrawing indictments in cases related to President Lee. (민주당은 지난 4월 대장동·쌍방울 대북송금 사건 등 윤석열 정부 시절 검찰의 수사·기소 과정에서 조작이 있었는지를 수사하는 특검법을 발의했다. 이 법안에는 특검이 관련 사건의 이첩을 요구하고 공소 유지 여부에 관여할 수 있도록 하는 내용이 담겼으며, 최근 민주당 내부에서도 공소 취소 권한을 포함해야 한다는 주장이 나오고 있다. 다만 민주당 안에서도 공소 취소 권한은 특검법에서 빼야 한다는 주장도 나온다. 국민의힘은 조작기소 특검이 결국 이 대통령 관련 사건의 공소 취소를 위한 것이라며 ‘공소취소 특검’이라고 반발하고 있다.)

People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk said at a Supreme Council meeting held at the National Assembly on the 31st, regarding President Lee Jae-myung's appointment of lawmaker Kim Seung-won as Minister of Justice, "Lawmaker Kim is a figure who has led the special counsel law for indictment withdrawal," and added, "His appointment as co-chair of the indictment withdrawal group shows that (the president) is all-in on canceling his trial, no matter how much the public opposes it." (국민의힘 장동혁 대표는 31일 국회에서 열린 최고위 회의에서 이재명 대통령이 김승원 의원을 법무부 장관에 기용한 것에 대해 “김 의원은 공소 취소 특검법 등을 주도하는 인물”이라면서 “공소취소모임 공동대표인 김 의원 지명은 국민이 아무리 반대해도 (이 대통령의)재판 취소에 올인하겠다는 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Next year's defense budget set at 73 trillion won, up 8.2%... Nuclear submarine budget reflected for first time at 100 billion won (내년 국방비 8.2% 늘어난 73조원 편성…핵잠 예산 1000억원 첫 반영)
item.description:
Next year's defense budget set at 73 trillion won, up 8.2%... Nuclear submarine budget reflected for first time at 100 billion won (내년 국방비 8.2% 늘어난 73조원 편성…핵잠 예산 1000억원 첫 반영)

The defense budget compiled by the government has exceeded 70 trillion won for the first time in history. (정부가 편성한 국방 예산이 사상 처음으로 70조 원을 돌파했다.)

The government announced that it has compiled next year's defense budget at 73.2777 trillion won, an increase of 5.5737 trillion won (approximately 8.2%) compared to this year's budget (67.704 trillion won). (정부는 내년도 국방 예산으로 올해 예산(67조7040억 원) 대비 5조5737억원(약 8.2%) 늘어난 73조2777억 원을 편성했다고 밝혔다.)

From next year's budget onward, the government will calculate the defense budget by including military administration expenses and other items in addition to force operation costs for maintaining military capabilities and force improvement costs for building military capabilities. Based on the government proposal compiled this time, the defense budget ratio to next year's gross domestic product (GDP) is projected at 2.33%. This is a slight increase compared to this year's figure (2.28%). (정부는 내년도 예산부터 군사력 운영을 위한 전력운영비와 군사력 건설을 위한 방위력개선비에 병무행정 예산 등까지 포함해 국방예산을 산정한다.이번에 편성된 정부안 기준으로 내년 국내총생산(GDP) 대비 국방예산 비율은 2.33%로 예측된다. 올해(2.28%) 대비 다소 늘어난 수준이다.)

The significant increase in defense spending stems from the policy stance of self-reliant defense based on our own technology and capabilities. The government is in agreement with the U.S. Trump administration, which has been demanding increased burden-sharing for defense from allies, on the direction of raising South Korea's defense spending to 3.5% of GDP by no later than 2035. (국방비 대폭 인상은 우리 기술과 전력을 기반으로 한 자주국방 추진 기조에 따른 것이다. 정부는 동맹의 방위 부담 증대를 요구해온 미 트럼프 행정부와 늦어도 2035년까지 한국의 국방비를 GDP 대비 3.5%까지 늘리는 방향에 공감한 상태다.)

Among next year's defense budget, force operation costs were compiled at 50.0416 trillion won, up 5.9% from this year, and force improvement costs at 22.7112 trillion won, up 13.8%. The military administration budget (524.9 billion won) increased by 1.4% from this year. (내년 국방예산 가운데 전력운영비는 올해보다 5.9% 증가한 50조416억 원, 방위력개선비는 13.8% 증가한 22조7112억 원이 편성됐다. 병무행정 예산(5249억 원)은 올해보다 1.4% 늘었다.)

The Ministry of National Defense explained, "In response to the rapidly changing security environment and the decline in military service resources, we focused on strengthening our military's self-reliant defense capabilities and transitioning from a manpower-centered military to a cutting-edge technology-centered military." (국방부는 “급변하는 안보환경과 병역자원 감소에 대응해 우리 군의 자주국방 역량을 강화하고, 병력 중심에서 첨단기술 중심의 군으로 전환하는 데 중점을 뒀다”고 설명했다.)

In particular, the budget for introducing core capabilities to achieve the transfer of wartime operational control (OPCON) without delay within the Lee Jae-myung administration's term was set at 21.3 trillion won, up from last year's figure (18.6 trillion won). (특히 전시작전통제권(전작권) 전환을 이재명 정부 임기 내 차질 없이 이루기 위한 핵심전력 도입 예산이 지난해(18조6000억원)보다 늘어난 21조3000억원으로 책정됐다.)

This is intended to secure early the core capabilities needed to establish a Korea-led combined defense system after the OPCON transfer. A budget of approximately 100 billion won for the introduction of a nuclear-powered submarine, promoted as a national strategic project, has been reflected in next year's defense budget for the first time. (전작권 전환 이후 한국군 주도 연합방위체계를 구축하기 위한 핵심 능력을 조기에 확보하려는 의도다. 국가전략사업으로 추진하는 핵추진잠수함 도입을 위한 예산 약 1000억 원이 내년도 국방예산에 처음으로 반영됐다.)

The special bill on nuclear submarines that the government is currently pushing to legislate contains provisions that allow the nuclear submarine project to be excluded from the mandatory feasibility study that large weapons system acquisition projects must undergo before commencement. It is also known that the government is considering integrating the basic design and detailed design phases of the nuclear submarine without separating them. (정부가 현재 제정을 추진 중인 핵잠 특별법안에는 핵잠 사업은 대형 무기체계 획득사업 착수 전 의무적으로 거쳐야 하는 사업타당성 조사 대상에서 제외할 수 있다는 내용이 담겨 있다. 핵잠 기본설계와 상세설계 절차를 구분하지 않고 통합해 진행하는 방안도 염두에 두고 있는 것으로 알려졌다.)

The budget for mass production of the domestically developed supersonic fighter KF-21 has been significantly increased to 3.3 trillion won from this year's 1.4 trillion won. Next year's budget includes funds (150 billion won) to commence follow-up mass production in parallel with the initial mass production quantity scheduled for delivery in 2027. (국산 초음속 전투기 KF-21 양산을 위한 예산은 올해 1조4000억원에서 대폭 늘어난 3조3000억원이 반영됐다. 내년 예산에는 2027년 인도가 예정된 초도 양산 물량과 더불어 후속 양산에도 병행 착수하기 위한 예산(1500억원)이 반영됐다.)

In addition, to improve the Korean military's command capabilities for Korea-led combined defense operations, projects will be pursued to upgrade the performance of air-ground communication radios and to newly establish the wartime military information distribution system for the Combined Component Command. To strengthen capabilities to respond to North Korea's nuclear and missile threats, the fielding timeline for Medium-altitude Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (MUAV) and Long-range Surface-to-Air Missiles (L-SAM) will be advanced by approximately one year. (또 한국군 주도의 연합방위작전 지휘 능력 향상을 위해 공지(空地)통신무전기 성능을 개량하고, 연합구성군사령부의 전시 군사정보유통체계를 새로 구축하는 사업을 추진한다. 북한 핵·미사일 위협 대응 능력 강화를 위해선 중고도정찰용 무인항공기(MUAV)와 장거리지대공유도무기(L-SAM) 전력화 시기를 1년가량 당긴다.)

Budget has also been intensively compiled to proactively respond to the decline in military service resources. As active-duty resources become insufficient, the standing reserve force will be expanded from 3,700 to 7,000 personnel to enhance the elite quality of reserve forces. For this purpose, a budget of 25.6 billion won, significantly increased from this year's 8.7 billion won, will be invested. (병역 자원 감소에 선제적으로 대응하기 위한 예산도 집중 편성됐다. 현역 자원이 부족해지는 만큼 예비전력 정예화를 위해 상비예비군 규모를 3700명에서 7000 명으로 확대한다. 이를 위해 올해 87억 원에서 대폭 늘어난 256억 원의 예산을 투입한다.)

A budget has also been newly reflected to pilot the outsourcing of non-combat duties such as weeding, snow removal, and facility management to civilian contractors so that active-duty soldiers can focus on training and combat missions. This is a pilot project to entrust comprehensive management including weeding for one GOP battalion (900 million won) and security for six civilian control line posts and two garrisons (2.5 billion won) to civilians. (현역 장병이 훈련·전투 임무에 집중하도록 제초, 제설, 시설관리 등 비전투 임무의 민간위탁을 시범 시행하는 예산도 새로 반영됐다. 1개 GOP 대대의 제초 등 종합관리(9억원), 6개 민통초소 및 2개 주둔지 경비(25억원)를 민간에 위탁하는 시범 사업이다.)

Additionally, in preparation for the changing nature of modern warfare, budget will be invested in expanding drone capabilities and a multilayered anti-drone defense system. Plans include commencing research and development on swarm drones and pursuing the acquisition of capabilities such as medium-range loitering munitions, squad-level small anti-personnel loitering munitions, and small attack drones. (또 변화하는 현대전 양상에 대비해 드론 전력 및 대(對)드론 다층 방어체계 확충에 예산을 투입한다. 군집드론 연구개발에 착수하고 중거리 자폭드론, 분대급 소형 대인 자폭드론, 소형 공격드론 등 전력 확보를 추진할 계획이다.)

Budget has also been compiled to improve the treatment of non-commissioned officers and other military leaders, as part of expanding the recruitment of technology-intensive non-commissioned officers, a key element of the 'selective enlistment system' taking effect next year. (내년부터 시행되는 ‘선택적 모병제’ 핵심 내용으로 신설되는 기술집약형부사관 모집 확대 등 차원에서 군 간부 처우 개선 예산도 편성됐다.)

Plans call for raising the base pay for sergeants at the first pay grade to approximately 3 million won per month, and increasing the incentive bonus for short-term service non-commissioned officers upon commissioning from the current 10 million won to 12 million won. Additionally, a 'matching savings' program will be newly established, investing 18.9 billion won to provide up to 300,000 won per month for three years to short-term service non-commissioned officers upon commissioning. (하사 1호봉 기준 보수를 월 300만 원 수준으로 인상할 계획이며 단기복무부사관 임관자 대상 장려금도 현 1000만원에서 1200만원으로 올린다. 또 189억원을 들여 단기복무부사관 임관자를 대상으로 월 최대 30만 원을 3년간 지원하는 ‘매칭적금’을 신설할 예정이다.)

Meanwhile, following the designation of the Gwangju military airfield site as the 'Honam Semiconductor Cluster' site, a budget of 316.9 billion won has been reflected for next year to temporarily relocate the functions of the Air Force's 1st Fighter Wing stationed there to Air Force bases in Yecheon and Seosan. (한편 광주 군 공항의 ‘호남 반도체 클러스터 부지’ 지정에 따라 이곳에 주둔한 공군 제1전투비행단 기능을 공군 예천·서산기지 등에 임시 배치하기 위한 예산은 내년에 3169억 원이 반영됐다.)

The budget for the integration of the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies, which the government is pursuing, has not been reflected in next year's budget for now. It is known that the government is considering reflecting it in the 2028 budget after conducting a feasibility study next year. (정부가 추진 중인 육·해·공군 사관학교 통합 예산은 내년도에는 일단 반영되지 않았다. 정부는 내년 사업타당성 조사를 거쳐 2028년 예산 반영을 염두에 두고 있는 것으로 알려졌다.)

item.title: People Power Party Calls for Parliamentary Investigation into Leveraged ETF Introduction After Kim Yong-beom's Resignation (국힘, 김용범 사퇴에 “레버리지 ETF 도입 국정조사 추진”)
item.description:
People Power Party Calls for Parliamentary Investigation into Leveraged ETF Introduction After Kim Yong-beom's Resignation (국힘, 김용범 사퇴에 “레버리지 ETF 도입 국정조사 추진”)

The People Power Party said on the 1st regarding Kim Yong-beom's resignation as chief of staff for policy at the presidential office, "Apart from his resignation, a parliamentary investigation and other fact-finding measures are absolutely necessary regarding the hasty introduction of single-stock leveraged ETFs." <<> Chief Whip Jeong Jeom-sik told reporters at the National Assembly that day, "We urge the dismissal of the remaining two of the 'leveraged ETF trio'—Financial Services Commission Chairman Lee Eok-won and Financial Supervisory Service Governor Lee Chan-jin," adding this statement. <<> Chief Whip Jeong said, "The economic leaders of both the presidential office and the cabinet have now been replaced, but this must not simply be a cosmetic reshuffle and should lead to a substantive change in policy direction." He added, "I think that with public sentiment worsening following last weekend's second cabinet reshuffle announcement, and especially with the growing backlash over Kim Seung-won's nomination as 'Minister of Prosecution Withdrawal' (Minister of Justice), they threw out another smoke bomb in a hurry. This is effectively admitting the cabinet reshuffle has already failed." <<> Senior Deputy Chief Whip Choi Su-jin said, "Kim's dismissal is only natural, but shouldn't someone take responsibility? It shouldn't be just a tail-cutting exercise, and from our standpoint, we plan to submit a request for a parliamentary investigation." <<> Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk also pointed out on Facebook that day that Kim had spearheaded the introduction of single-stock leveraged ETFs, saying, "And yet, of all people, Kim Yong-beom's son works at a securities firm. Lee Chan-jin's son, the FSC chairman, also works at the same securities firm. Isn't this an obvious target for investigation?" <<> Jang said, "The Board of Audit and Inspection said it would audit, but there's been no news at all," adding, "How can an agency that overturned even its previous audits and is busy pandering to the administration conduct a proper audit?" He continued, "There's no way Kim Yong-beom did this alone without President Lee Jae-myung's knowledge. Kim Yong-beom is the tail; the body is President Lee Jae-myung." <<> He added, "With the prosecution abolished, there's no proper investigative body either. This is why they got rid of the prosecution, it seems. The damage to the people amounts to 54 trillion won. At the very least, a special counsel is needed." <<> Lawmaker Na Kyung-won said on Facebook that day, "Behind the hasty introduction of single-stock leveraged ETFs lies a 'conflict of interest': the sons of economic commander-in-chief Kim Yong-beom and financial supervisory chief Lee Chan-jin are both employed at Mirae Asset, the biggest beneficiary company. This is not a simple policy failure but a serious matter that requires close scrutiny into the possibility of deliberate capital market disruption and power-involved financial crimes." <<> Lawmaker Na said, "It shouldn't end with a resignation; there must be a thorough investigation and prosecution. A parliamentary investigation into the public damage from the ETFs must be conducted at the National Assembly level." She added, "We must thoroughly verify not only those above and behind the hasty listing of leveraged ETFs, but also what economic gains Kim Yong-beom and Lee Chan-jin's children reaped from this situation. We will also consider strong criminal complaints against the 'ETF public damage trio,' including Kim Yong-beom." (국민의힘은 1일 김용범 청와대 정책실장 사퇴와 관련해 “사퇴와 별개로 단일 종목 레버리지 ETF 졸속 도입에 대해선 국정조사 등 진상 규명 조치가 반드시 필요하다”고 했다.)

item.title: DP's Park Hee-seung: "Opinions on Dropping Indictment Differ Even Within Party... No Need for Opposition to Worry" (與 박희승 “공소취소, 당내에서도 의견 다 달라…野 걱정 안해도 돼”)
item.description:
DP's Park Hee-seung: "Opinions on Dropping Indictment Differ Even Within Party... No Need for Opposition to Worry" (與 박희승 “공소취소, 당내에서도 의견 다 달라…野 걱정 안해도 돼”)

Park Hee-seung, deputy policy chief of the Democratic Party of Korea (DP), said on the 1st regarding the dropping of the indictment in the case of President Lee Jae-myung, "Opinions differ even within our party," adding, "You don't need to worry that much." (더불어민주당 박희승 정책위 부의장이 이재명 대통령 사건의 공소취소와 관련해 “민주당 내에서도 의견이 다 다르다”라며 “그렇게 걱정 안 하셔도 될 것 같다”고 1일 말했다.)

Park, a former judge, has also publicly pointed out that the party's plan to increase the number of Supreme Court justices, part of its judicial reform proposal, could weaken lower courts. (판사 출신 박 의장은 민주당의 사법개편안 일환인 ‘대법관 증원’에 대해서도 하급심이 부실화할 수 있다는 점을 공개적으로 지적한 바 있다.)

At a joint meeting held on the 1st by the policy committees of the DP and the People Power Party (PPP), Park made these remarks in response to a question from Kim Eun-hye, deputy policy chief of the PPP, about the controversy surrounding Kim Seung-won, the nominee for Minister of Justice, regarding the dropped indictment. Kim also said, "Even if it takes two or three days, the confirmation hearing must be conducted rigorously." (민주당과 국민의힘 정책위원회가 1일 개최한 연석회의 자리에서 박 부의장은 김은혜 국민의힘 부의장의 김승원 법무부장관 후보자의 공소취소 관련 논란 질의에 이 같이 답했다. 김 부의장은 “이틀, 사흘이 걸리더라도 청문회를 엄격하게 해야 한다”고도 했다.)

Additionally, Kim targeted the DP's real estate tax proposals, saying, "The saying 'tax when buying, capital gains tax when selling, inheritance tax when dying' is circulating again," and demanded that the DP revise the real estate tax reform bill expected to be put to a plenary vote that day. (또 김 부의장은 민주당이 추진하는 부동산 세제를 겨냥해 “사자니 보유세, 팔자니 양도세, 죽자니 상속세라는 말이 다시 회자되고 있다”며 이날 본회의 처리가 예상되는 부동산 세제 개편안의 수정을 민주당에 요구했다.)

Kwon Chil-seung, DP policy chief, said, "First, second, and third priority is people's livelihoods," adding, "Let's boldly agree on what we can agree on, and listen more actively on points of disagreement." He also cited similar pledges from both parties—such as addressing low birth rates, the climate crisis, public safety, protecting small business owners, and youth policies—and proposed, "Let's quickly process issues we can handle together to achieve tangible results for people's livelihoods." (권칠승 민주당 정책위의장은 “첫째도, 둘째도, 셋째도 민생”이라며 “합의할 수 있는 사항부터 과감하게 합의하고 이견이 있는 부분은 더 열심히 듣겠다”고 했다. 또 저출생·기후위기·국민안전·소상공인 보호·청년정책 등 양당의 유사 공약을 언급하며 “함께 처리할 수 있는 현안들은 빠르게 처리해 확실한 민생 성과를 만들자”고 제안했다.)

Im I-ja, policy chief of the PPP, proposed three items: △swift processing of common livelihood pledges and legislative tasks for both parties, △thorough deliberation and supplementary legislation on contentious bills, and △operation of a standing communication channel among policy chiefs. In particular, she raised the need for supplementary legislation, saying, "The 'Yellow Envelope Bill' continues to cause confusion and disputes on the ground over the scope of employers and other issues." (임이자 국민의힘 의장은 △양당 공통 민생공약·입법과제 신속 처리 △쟁점법안 충분한 숙의와 보완입법 △정책위의장단 상시 소통채널 가동 등 3가지를 제안했다. 특히 “노란봉투법은 사용자 범위 등을 둘러싸고 현장의 혼란과 분쟁이 계속되고 있다”며 보완입법 필요성을 제기했다.)

She also said, "The proposal to abolish supplementary investigation powers and the Criminal Procedure Act raise concerns about investigative gaps and delays in promptly restoring the rights of crime victims," and called for discussing complementary measures together. (또 “보완수사권 폐지안과 형사소송법 역시 수사 공백과 범죄 피해자의 신속한 권리구제 우려가 있다”며 보완책을 함께 논의하자고 했다.)

item.title: Lee’s ‘Biting Joke’: “If You Can’t Stabilize Chuseok Prices, I’ll Revoke Your Nomination” (‘뼈 있는 농담’ 던진 李 “추석 물가 못 잡으면 지명 취소다”)
item.description:
Lee’s ‘Biting Joke’: “If You Can’t Stabilize Chuseok Prices, I’ll Revoke Your Nomination” (‘뼈 있는 농담’ 던진 李 “추석 물가 못 잡으면 지명 취소다”)

President Lee Jae-myung said to Finance and Economy Minister nominee Lee Hyeong-il at a cabinet meeting on the 1st, “If you can’t stabilize Chuseok prices, I might revoke your nomination.” That day, President Lee had accepted the resignation of Cheong Wa Dae Policy Chief Kim Yong-beom, so his remarks at the cabinet meeting are being interpreted in government circles as a “biting joke.” Lee Hyeong-il, a former first vice minister of the Finance and Economy Ministry, was nominated on the 30th of last month as the successor to Deputy Prime Minister Koo Yun-cheol. <<> During the cabinet meeting, President Lee pointed out to the nominee the recurring annual problem of rising prices for Chuseok holiday goods, asking, “Are you confident this time?” and pressing for a solution. When the nominee repeatedly insisted, “I will definitely get it under control,” President Lee burst into laughter and issued a joking warning: “Really? I could revoke your nomination as Finance and Economy Minister, you know. Are you sure?” The nominee again replied, “I will do so.” <<> He continued, “I may have made a bit of an over-the-top joke, but the price issue is the area where our people feel things most keenly.” He added, “Recent tax revenues are looking fine, and economic indicators are said to be improving, but shouldn’t we make sure people don’t feel like ‘What about me, then?’ At the very least, we need to provide solid support during the holidays so people don’t feel disheartened.” He also said, “Beyond what we’ve organized today, if there are additional measures we can take, please review them with an open mind.” <<> He also warned of strong on-site enforcement against the rampant “tourist trap pricing” at vacation spots during the holiday season. After confirming again, “If they’re caught the first time, we immediately suspend their business for five days, right?” regarding failure to display prices or violations of posted prices at tourist sites, President Lee ordered strict action, noting, “From the business’s perspective, that would be quite a blow.” The government plans to link regional currency discount support, implemented through a total-amount subsidy approach, with the issuance of Onnuri gift certificates to minimize the burden on people’s livelihoods during the holidays. (이재명 대통령이 1일 국무회의에서 이형일 재경기획부 장관 후보자를 향해 “추석 물가를 못 잡으면 지명을 취소할 수도 있다”고 했다. 이날 이 대통령은 김용범 청와대 정책실장의 사표를 수리했기 때문에 국무회의 발언을 두고 ‘뼈 있는 농담’이라는 해석이 관가에서 나온다. 재경부 1차관 출신인 이 후보자는 지난달 30일 구윤철 부총리 후임으로 지명됐다.)

item.title: [Breaking News] Non-resident single-home comprehensive real estate tax deduction raised from 900 million to 1.2 billion won… Government proposal revised ([속보] 비거주 1주택 종부세 공제 9억→12억… 정부안 수정)
item.description:
[Breaking News] Non-resident single-home comprehensive real estate tax deduction raised from 900 million to 1.2 billion won… Government proposal revised ([속보] 비거주 1주택 종부세 공제 9억→12억… 정부안 수정)

In the real estate tax-related government proposal announced on the 1st, the government decided to raise the basic deduction for the comprehensive real estate tax for non-residents owning a single home from the initially proposed 900 million won to 1.2 billion won. For non-resident married couples holding a single home under joint ownership, the per-person deduction was adjusted from 400 million won to 600 million won, allowing a total deduction of 1.2 billion won, the same as for sole ownership. The plan to raise the cap on the comprehensive real estate tax burden to 200% was also withdrawn, with the current 150% cap maintained. (정부가 1일 발표한 부동산 세제 관련 정부안에서 비거주 1주택자의 종합부동산세 기본공제를 당초 9억원에서 12억원으로 올리기로 했다. 비거주 부부 공동명의 1주택자는 1인당 공제액을 4억원에서 6억원으로 조정해 단독명의와 마찬가지로 총 12억원을 공제받도록 했다. 종부세 세 부담 상한도 당초 200%로 높이려던 방침을 철회하고 현행 150%를 유지하기로 했다.)

As a result, the issue of the total basic deduction for the comprehensive real estate tax differing depending on whether a non-resident single-home owner holds the property under sole or joint marital ownership has been resolved. The government's initial tax reform proposal, released on the 3rd of last month, had called for lowering the basic deduction for non-resident single-home owners from 1.2 billion won to 900 million won, and for non-resident married couples with joint ownership, allowing only a deduction of 400 million won each, totaling 800 million won. (이에 따라 비거주 1주택자의 경우 단독명의인지 부부 공동명의인지에 따라 종부세 기본공제 총액이 달라지는 문제는 해소됐다. 정부가 지난달 3일 내놓은 당초 세제개편안은 비거주 1주택자의 기본공제를 12억원에서 9억원으로 낮추고, 비거주 부부 공동명의의 경우 각각 4억원씩 총 8억원만 공제하도록 하는 내용이었다.)

The Democratic Party of Korea stated on the same day, "We fundamentally agree with the intent of the government's tax reform proposal to favor actual residents," but added, "The tax equity among single-home owners as perceived by the public and the predictability of the tax burden must also be strongly considered." The Democratic Party had been urging the government to avoid differentiating the basic deduction for the comprehensive real estate tax for single-home owners based on residence status and to maintain the current cap on the tax burden. At a high-level ruling party-government consultation held on the 23rd of last month, the party also requested that the government not distinguish between resident and non-resident single-home owners. (더불어민주당은 이날 “정부 세제 개편안의 실거주 우대 취지에 기본적으로 동의한다”면서도 “국민께서 체감하는 1주택자 간 과세 형평성과 세 부담의 예측 가능성 또한 강하게 고려돼야 한다”고 밝혔다. 민주당은 그동안 1주택자 종부세 기본공제에서 거주 여부에 따른 차등을 두지 않는 방안과 세 부담 상한을 현행대로 유지하는 방안 등을 정부에 요구해 왔다. 지난달 23일 고위당정협의회에서도 정부에 1주택자의 거주·비거주 구분을 두지 말 것을 요청했다.)

With the government adjusting the basic deduction for non-resident single-home owners to 1.2 billion won and maintaining the 150% cap on the tax burden, some of the Democratic Party's supplementary demands appear to have been partially reflected. However, since the original government proposal had raised the basic deduction for actual resident single-home owners from the current 1.2 billion won to 1.4 billion won, the Democratic Party's demand to eliminate the deduction gap based on residence status entirely has not been fully adopted. The original government proposal was designed to favor actual residents through tax benefits while strengthening the burden on non-residents and high-priced homes. (정부가 비거주 1주택자의 기본공제를 12억원으로 조정하고 세 부담 상한을 150%로 유지하면서 민주당이 제기한 보완 요구가 일부 반영된 것으로 보인다. 다만 당초 정부안에서 실거주 1주택자의 기본공제를 현행 12억원에서 14억원으로 높이기로 한 만큼, 거주 여부에 따른 공제 차등 자체를 없애자는 민주당 요구가 전부 반영된 것은 아니다. 기존 정부안은 실거주자를 세제상 우대하면서 비거주·고가 주택에 대한 부담을 강화하는 방향으로 설계됐다.)

The Democratic Party said, "We will continue to closely examine the impact the government proposal will have on the public's burden and the housing market during the parliamentary deliberation process and supplement any necessary aspects." (민주당은 “앞으로도 국회 논의 과정에서 정부안이 국민 부담과 주택시장에 미칠 영향을 면밀히 살피고 필요한 사항을 보완해 나가겠다”고 했다.)

Criticism has also been raised that the government's tax reform proposal, which was repeatedly revised and re-reviewed immediately after its announcement, has undermined policy credibility. The government announced the tax reform proposal on the 3rd of last month, but four days later, President Lee Jae-myung ordered a full re-review of some key measures, including the ISA. In the ten days following the announcement, the government issued 29 explanatory materials, a significant number of which were related to real estate taxes. Since taxes, even before implementation, can affect decision-making by the public and actual buyers regarding home purchases, holdings, and asset management, the repeated short-term changes to the government proposal have been criticized for increasing market confusion and policy uncertainty. The government, in response, maintains that the tax law amendment is not a finalized version and that the process of refining it through opinion gathering is a normal legislative procedure. (정부의 세제 개편안이 발표 직후 잇따라 수정·재검토된 데 대해서도 정책 신뢰도를 떨어뜨렸다는 지적이 나온다. 정부는 지난달 3일 세제개편안을 발표했지만 나흘 뒤 이재명 대통령이 ISA 등 일부 핵심 방안의 전면 재검토를 지시했다. 발표 이후 열흘 동안 정부가 내놓은 해명 자료만 29건에 달했고, 이 가운데 상당수가 부동산 세제 관련이었다.세제는 실제 시행 전이라도 발표 자체가 주택 매매나 보유, 자산 운용 등 국민과 실수요자의 의사 결정에 영향을 미치는 만큼, 정부안이 단기간에 거듭 바뀌면서 시장 혼란과 정책 불확실성을 키웠다는 비판이 제기된다. 정부는 이에 대해 세법 개정안은 확정안이 아니며 의견 수렴을 거쳐 보완하는 정상적인 입법 과정이라는 입장이다.)

item.title: Kim Yong-beom, Cheong Wa Dae Policy Chief, Resigns... President Lee Accepts (김용범 靑 정책실장 사퇴...李대통령 수리)
item.description:
Kim Yong-beom, Cheong Wa Dae Policy Chief, Resigns... President Lee Accepts (김용범 靑 정책실장 사퇴...李대통령 수리)

<<>> The presidential office announced on the 1st that Policy Chief Kim Yong-beom expressed his intention to resign on the 31st of last month, and President Lee Jae-myung accepted the resignation on the 1st. With criticism growing over government policies such as real estate amid the sharp fluctuations in the stock market, and with approval ratings continuing to decline as a result, it was said that Chief Kim offered his resignation. He is the first Cheong Wa Dae chief-level official to resign under the current administration. ()

Chief Kim had led efforts including the introduction of single-stock leveraged exchange-traded funds (ETFs), which were cited as a cause of the sharp stock market swings, as well as the formulation of a tax reform plan that reflected recently controversial real estate policies, the Yongsan Park development, and the differential application of the basic exemption amount for the comprehensive real estate tax for non-resident single-homeowners. Accordingly, the opposition party had raised the "Kim Yong-beom responsibility theory," and recently, even within the ruling camp, arguments emerged pointing to Chief Kim, saying that "someone must take responsibility" amid the falling approval ratings of the president and the party. (청와대는 1일 김용범 정책실장이 지난 31일 사의를 표했고, 이재명 대통령은 1일 사표를 수리했다고 밝혔다. 주식시장 급변동 여파에 부동산 등 정부 정책에 대한 비판이 커지고 이에 따른 지지율 하락이 계속되자 김 실장이 사의를 표했다는 말이 나왔다. 현 정부에서 청와대 실장급 사퇴는 김 실장이 처음이다.)

Until recently, Cheong Wa Dae had said that replacing Chief Kim was never under consideration. The stance was that "replacement is difficult" given that if Chief Kim resigned, responsibility for policy failures would shift to the presidential office, and that the investment negotiations with the United States, which Chief Kim had led since last year, were still ongoing, with no "first U.S. investment" announcement yet made. (김 실장은 주식시장 급변동 원인으로 지목된 단일종목 레버리지 상장지수펀드(ETF) 도입, 최근 논란이 되고 있는 부동산 정책과 용산공원 개발, 비거주 1주택자에 대한 종합부동산세 기본 공제액 차등 적용 등이 반영된 세제 개편안 마련 등을 주도해 왔다. 이에 야당에서는 ‘김용범 책임론’을 제기해 왔고, 최근엔 여권 내에서도 대통령과 당 지지율 하락세에 “책임지는 사람이 있어야 한다”며 김 실장을 지목하는 주장이 나왔다.)

However, as approval ratings continued to decline due to policy failures, voices grew that a rebound would be difficult without Chief Kim's resignation. President Lee replaced Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Economy and Finance Koo Yun-cheol and Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Kim Yun-deok on the 30th in a bid to refresh the atmosphere, but the fact that Chief Kim, who held the reins on policy decisions, was not included in the reshuffle sparked resentment that spread within the ruling camp and the public service community, which was said to have prompted Chief Kim's resignation. (청와대는 최근까지도 김 실장 교체는 검토한 적 없다고 했었다. 김 실장이 사퇴할 경우 정책 실패의 책임이 청와대로 몰리고, 김 실장이 지난해부터 주도해 온 대미 투자 협상이 아직 ‘대미 투자 1호’ 발표를 하지 못하는 등 진행 중이라는 점 등을 감안해 ‘교체는 어렵다’는 쪽이었다.)

item.title: Innovation Party calls for Financial Services Commission Chairman Lee Bok-hyun's resignation, following Kim Yong-beom (조국혁신당 “김용범 이어 이억원 금융위원장도 사퇴하라”)
item.description:
Innovation Party calls for Financial Services Commission Chairman Lee Bok-hyun's resignation, following Kim Yong-beom (조국혁신당 “김용범 이어 이억원 금융위원장도 사퇴하라”)

The Innovation Party on Monday demanded the resignation of Financial Services Commission (FSC) Chairman Lee Bok-hyun, holding him responsible for the introduction of single-stock leveraged exchange-traded funds (ETFs) and the subsequent response. This came after Kim Yong-beom, chief of staff for policy at the presidential office, stepped down the same day, extending the call for accountability to the head of the financial regulator. (조국혁신당이 1일 단일종목 레버리지 상장지수펀드(ETF) 도입과 사후 대응의 책임을 물어 이억원 금융위원장의 사퇴를 요구했다. 이날 김용범 청와대 정책실장이 물러난 데 이어 금융 당국 수장에게까지 책임론을 제기한 것이다.)

In a statement released that day, Innovation Party spokesperson Lim Myeong-hee said, "The introduction of single-stock leveraged ETFs is not a matter that can be settled with the resignation of former Chief Kim," and "We urge FSC Chairman Lee Bok-hyun to resign." Lim assessed Kim's resignation as "stepping down to take responsibility for the failure of government-directed finance." However, the presidential office only confirmed the acceptance of Kim's resignation that day without officially citing the single-stock leveraged ETF controversy as the reason. (임명희 조국혁신당 대변인은 이날 논평에서 “단일종목 레버리지 ETF 도입은 김 전 실장의 사퇴로 정리될 사안이 아니다”라며 “이억원 금융위원장의 사퇴를 촉구한다”고 했다. 임 대변인은 김 전 실장의 사퇴를 두고 “관치 금융의 실패를 책임지고 물러난 것”이라고 평가했다. 다만 청와대는 이날 김 전 실장의 사표 수리 사실만 밝혔을 뿐 단일종목 레버리지 ETF 논란을 사퇴 이유로 공식 언급하지는 않았다.)

The Innovation Party specifically criticized the FSC for only moving to tighten regulations after concerns over market volatility and investor losses had grown following the product's launch. Lim said, "Only after individual investor losses surged did they resort to belated measures such as raising deposit requirements, capping leverage ratios, and setting investment limits, which undermined market trust and triggered a contraction in liquidity." (조국혁신당은 특히 금융위원회가 상품 출시 이후 시장 변동성과 투자자 손실 우려가 커진 뒤에야 규제 강화에 나섰다고 비판했다. 임 대변인은 “개인투자자 손실이 급증한 후에야 예탁금 상향, 배율 제한, 투자 한도 설정 등 늑장 대응으로 시장 신뢰를 무너뜨리고 수급 위축을 자초했다”고 했다.)

The FSC announced in January its plan to introduce single-stock leveraged products based on major domestic stocks, citing the need to resolve regulatory disparities between domestic and foreign ETFs. Subsequently, ±2x single-stock leveraged products based on stocks such as Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix were launched on May 27. At the time, the FSC described them as high-risk products with greater loss potential than regular ETFs and advised investors to "invest within their own loss tolerance and at their own responsibility." (금융위는 지난 1월 국내외 ETF 간 규제 차이를 해소한다며 국내 우량주를 기초자산으로 하는 단일종목 레버리지 상품 도입 방침을 발표했다. 이후 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스 등을 기초로 한 ±2배 단일종목 레버리지 상품이 5월 27일 출시됐다. 금융위는 당시 일반 ETF보다 손실 가능성이 높은 고위험 상품이라며 투자자가 “본인의 손실 감내 한도 내에서 자기 책임 하에 투자할 것”을 권고했다.)

However, as trading volumes surged after the launch and concerns grew that they could amplify stock price volatility, the FSC and related agencies announced supplementary measures on July 16. They temporarily suspended new listings of single-stock products, raised the basic deposit requirement for individual retail investors from 10 million won to 30 million won in cash, and banned advertising and promotional marketing. Subsequently, Chairman Lee indicated that additional regulatory measures, such as lowering leverage ratios and setting per-investor investment limits, would also be considered. (그러나 출시 후 거래 규모가 급증하고 주가 변동성을 키울 수 있다는 논란이 커지자 금융위 등 관계 기관은 7월 16일 보완책을 내놨다. 단일종목 상품의 신규 상장을 잠정 중단하고, 개인 일반투자자의 기본예탁금을 1000만원에서 현금 3000만원으로 올리는 한편 광고·이벤트성 마케팅도 금지했다. 이후 이억원 위원장은 레버리지 배율 하향과 개인별 투자 한도 설정 등 추가 규제 방안도 검토하겠다고 밝혔다.)

Lim also criticized the financial authorities' investor caution notices, claiming they "expanded the damage and then shifted responsibility onto investors to save themselves." She added, "To restore lost trust, the financial authorities must take responsible action regarding their oversight and response." (임 대변인은 금융 당국의 투자자 유의 안내에 대해서도 “피해를 키워 놓고 면피를 위해 투자자들에게 책임을 전가했다”고 주장했다. 이어 “잃어버린 신뢰 회복을 위해서라도 금융 당국의 감독과 대응에 대한 책임 있는 행동이 따라야 한다”고 했다.)

Former Chief Kim stepped down after President Lee accepted his resignation that day, roughly 15 months into the Lee Jae-myung administration. In recent weeks, political circles had raised questions about Kim's accountability amid worsening public sentiment over single-stock leveraged products and housing policies. The People Power Party also called Kim's resignation "a scapegoat move" that day, arguing for a parliamentary investigation and a special counsel probe into the process of introducing single-stock leveraged ETFs. (김 전 실장은 이날 이 대통령이 사표를 수리하면서 이재명 정부 출범 약 15개월 만에 물러났다. 최근 정치권에서는 단일종목 레버리지 상품과 부동산 정책 등을 둘러싼 여론 악화와 맞물려 김 전 실장에 대한 책임론이 제기돼 왔다. 국민의힘도 이날 김 전 실장의 사퇴를 두고 “꼬리 자르기”라며 단일종목 레버리지 ETF 도입 과정에 대한 국정조사와 특검 필요성을 주장했다.)

item.title: Kim Ui-gyeom named ruling party secretary on Legislation and Judiciary Committee... Opposition protests, "Is 'Cheongdam-dong rumor' and 'Heukseok Daegam' appropriate?" (與 법사위 간사에 김의겸 내정... 野 “‘청담동 괴담’ ‘흑석대감’ 적절하냐” 반발)
item.description:
Kim Ui-gyeom named ruling party secretary on Legislation and Judiciary Committee... Opposition protests, "Is 'Cheongdam-dong rumor' and 'Heukseok Daegam' appropriate?" (與 법사위 간사에 김의겸 내정... 野 “‘청담동 괴담’ ‘흑석대감’ 적절하냐” 반발)

The Democratic Party of Korea on the 1st appointed second-term lawmaker Kim Ui-gyeom as the ruling party secretary on the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee, a position left vacant after lawmaker Kim Seung-won was nominated as the Minister of Justice candidate. In response, the People Power Party protested, saying, "We question whether Kim, of the 'Cheongdam-dong drinking rumor' and 'Heukseok Daegam' incidents, is appropriate to serve as the ruling party secretary on the Legislation and Judiciary Committee." (더불어민주당은 1일 김승원 의원이 법무부 장관 후보자로 지명되면서 공석이 된 국회 법제사법위원회 여당 간사에 재선의 김의겸 의원을 선임했다. 이에 대해 국민의힘은 “‘청담동 술자리 괴담’ ‘흑석도사’ 사건의 김 의원이 법사위 여당 간사를 맡는게 적절한지 의문”이라며 반발했다.)

The Democratic Party designated Kim as the ruling party secretary on the committee that day and sought to propose and process the secretary appointment motion at the committee meeting in the afternoon. In response, People Power Party lawmaker Kwak Kyu-taek said, "When people hear Kim's name, they will think of two things: the 'Cheongdam-dong drinking rumor' and the 'Heukseok Daegam.'" He added, "I question whether (Kim) is appropriate as the ruling party secretary on the Legislation and Judiciary Committee." (민주당은 이날 김 의원을 법사위 여당 간사로 내정하고, 오후 법사위 회의에서 간사 선임안을 상정·처리하려 했다. 그러자 국민의힘 곽규택 의원은 “김 의원 이름을 들으면 국민들은 딱 두 가지를 떠올릴 것이다. ‘청담동 술자리 괴담’과 ‘흑석대감’ 두 가지”라며 “(김 의원이) 법사위 여당 간사로 적절한지 의문”이라고 했다.)

Kim, who served on the Legislation and Judiciary Committee in the 21st National Assembly, sparked controversy in October 2022 when he raised the so-called "Cheongdam-dong drinking allegation" during the committee's parliamentary audit of the Ministry of Justice. The claim was that then-Minister of Justice Han Dong-hoon had a late-night drinking session in July of that year at a bar in Cheongdam-dong, Seoul, with President Yoon Suk-yeol and around 30 lawyers from law firm Kim & Chang. However, cellist A, who claimed to have witnessed the gathering, testified a month later during police questioning that his claim of having witnessed the session was false. (21대 국회 법사위원으로 활동했던 김 의원은 2022년 10월 법사위의 법무부 국정감사에서 이른바 ‘청담동 술자리 의혹’을 제기해 논란이 됐었다. 한동훈 당시 법무부 장관이 그해 7월 윤석열 대통령과 김앤장 법률사무소 변호사 30여명 등과 서울 청담동의 한 술집에서 심야 술자리를 가졌다는 주장이었다. 그러나 술자리를 목격했다는 첼리스트 A씨는 한달 뒤 경찰 조사에서 당시 술자리를 목격했다는 자신의 말이 거짓이었다고 진술했다.)

In August of last year, in the first trial of the defamation lawsuit filed by independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon, a ruling was issued ordering Kim and others to pay 70 million won in damages to Han. Kim's mention of the allegation on a YouTube broadcast is subject to criminal defamation charges, and the trial is currently ongoing. (작년 8월 무소속 한동훈 의원이 낸 손해배상 소송 1심에선 김 의원 등이 한 의원에게 7000만원을 배상해야 한다는 판결이 나왔다. 김 의원이 유튜브 방송에서 해당 의혹을 언급한 것은 명예훼손죄가 적용돼 현재 재판이 진행 중이다.)

Additionally, Kim resigned from his position as spokesperson for the Moon Jae-in Blue House amid the "Heukseok-dong property speculation" controversy. (또 김 의원은 문재인 청와대 대변인 시절 ‘흑석동 부동산 투기’ 논란이 불거져 대변인직에서 사퇴했었다.)

The People Power Party also cited the case of last year when the Democratic Party blocked the appointment of People Power Party lawmaker Na Kyung-won as the opposition party secretary on the committee, citing her ongoing criminal trial in the so-called "fast-track case." Kwak said, "Last time, you refused to appoint the People Power Party's committee secretary for a whole year for reasons that were truly incomprehensible." He added, "Compared to Kim Ui-gyeom now, I absolutely cannot understand the reasons for blocking that secretary appointment then." (국민의힘은 지난해 민주당이 이른바 ‘패스트트랙 사건’으로 형사 재판을 받고 있다는 이유로 국민의힘 나경원 의원의 야당 간사 선임을 막았던 사례도 들었다. 곽 의원은 “지난번에 정말 이해할 수 없는 사유로 국민의힘 법사위 간사를 1년 동안이나 선임 안 해주지 않았느냐”며 “지금 김의겸 의원에 비하면 그때 간사 선임 (반대) 이유는 저는 도저히 이해할 수 없다”고 했다.)

In response, Democratic Party lawmaker Kim Yong-min said, "The reason Na Kyung-won wasn't appointed was that she was undergoing a criminal trial, and she had a conflict of interest because her spouse was serving as the chief judge of the Chuncheon District Court. She was also under investigation related to obstruction of President Yoon's arrest." He added, "It wasn't that she shouldn't serve as secretary—it was the position that she shouldn't be on the committee at all." (그러자 민주당 김용민 의원은 “나경원 의원이 선임이 안 됐던건, 형사 재판을 받고 있었고 결적적으로는 배우자가 춘천지방법원장으로 하고 있어 이해충돌의 문제가 있었다. 그리고 윤석열 체포방해죄와 관련해 수사를 받고 있었다”며 “간사를 하면 안된다가 아니라 아예 법사위에 계시면 안된다는 입장이었다”고 했다.)

People Power Party lawmaker Park Hyung-soo then said, "You said Na couldn't be secretary because she was on trial over the fast-track case, but Democratic Party lawmaker Park Beom-kye, who was also on trial over the same fast-track case, went on to become Minister of Justice." He asked, "Does that really serve as a (valid) reason for opposition?" (이에 국민의힘 박형수 의원은 “나 의원이 패스트트랙으로 재판을 받고 있어서 간사가 안 된다고 했는데, 똑같이 패스트트랙으로 재판받고 있었던 민주당 박범계 의원은 법무부 장관까지 했다”며 “그게 (반대) 사유가 되느냐”고 했다.)

Kim Ui-gyeom said, "Regarding the Heukseok-dong matter, the prosecution issued a no-charge disposition, and as for the Cheongdam-dong matter, wasn't that just a very turbulent time?" He added, "That matter I will face properly in court as it proceeds." (김의겸 의원은 “흑석동 건에 대해선 검찰이 무혐의 처분을 했고, 청담동 건은 당시 시절이 하수상하던 때 아니었냐”며 “그 일은 그 일대로 재판을 성실히 받겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee Nominates Kye Seung-gyun, Pusan National University Professor, as Chair of the National Intellectual Property Committee (李대통령, 국가지식재산위원장에 계승균 부산대 교수 지명)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung nominated Kye Seung-gyun, a professor at Pusan National University, as the chair of the National Intellectual Property Committee, according to a written briefing delivered by Senior Presidential Spokesperson Kang Yu-jeong on the 1st. The National Intellectual Property Committee is an organization under the President's authority, responsible for deliberating, coordinating, and reviewing policies in the field of intellectual property. (이재명 대통령은 국가지식재산위원회 위원장에 계승균 부산대 교수를 지명했다고 강유정 청와대 수석대변인이 1일 서면 브리핑을 통해 밝혔다. 국가지식재산위원회는 대통령소속 기관으로, 지식재산 분야의 정책을 심의·조정·점검하는 역할을 한다.)

Senior Spokesperson Kang described the new Chair Kye as "a legal scholar well-versed in intellectual property legislation who has expanded his expertise to include AI (artificial intelligence) and public contracts, and an expert who has contributed to the development of intellectual property policy and legislation through various government committees and academic activities." (강 수석대변인은 계 신임 위원장에 대해 “지식재산 법제에 정통하고 AI(인공지능), 공공계약에까지 전문성을 넓혀온 법학자로, 다양한 정부 위원회 및 학회 활동을 통해 지식재산 정책과 법제 발전에 기여한 전문가”라고 설명했다.)

She further stated, "He is the right person to proactively respond to changes in the new technology environment, such as AI and digital transformation, and to go beyond the creation and protection of intellectual property to make it a core driver of national growth," adding, "He will faithfully fulfill the role of a control tower for national intellectual property strategy by enhancing the professionalism and effectiveness of the National Intellectual Property Committee." (이어 “AI·디지털 전환 등 신기술 환경 변화에 선제적으로 대응해 지식재산 창출과 보호를 넘어 지식재산을 국가 성장의 핵심 동력으로 만들 적임자”라며 “국가지식재산위원회의 전문성과 실효성을 제고해 국가 지식재산 전략의 컨트롤타워 역할을 충실히 수행할 것”이라고 했다.)

Chair Kye, a legal expert in intellectual property rights, serves as a professor in the Division of Convergence Studies at Pusan National University and is also active as the president of the Korean Intellectual Property Society and a non-standing committee member of the Korea Copyright Commission. (지적재산권 관련 법 전문가인 계 위원장은 부산대 융합학부 교수로 재직하면서 한국지식재산학회 회장, 한국저작권위원회 비상임위원 등으로도 활동 중이다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok: "I Urged Police Reform as Prime Minister... We Must Uproot the Six Major Malpractices" (김민석 “총리 시절 경찰개혁 당부했는데… 6대 폐단 뿌리 뽑아야” )
item.description:
On the 1st, at the first meeting of the Police Reform Promotion Task Force, Democratic Party of Korea leader Kim Min-seok said, "When I was prime minister, I asked the police themselves fairly early on to come up with a police reform plan, but the results were not satisfactory" and "It seems that it is difficult for them to create a reform plan on their own." (더불어민주당 김민석 대표는 경찰개혁추진단 첫회의가 열린 1일 “제가 총리 시절, 꽤 일찍 경찰 개혁안을 만들어야 된다고 경찰 자체에 당부를 했는데, 그렇게 만족할 만은 못했다”며 “아무래도 자체적으로 개혁안을 만든다는 건 어려운 일인 것 같다”고 했다.)

Kim said on the same day, "Various measures must be devised as much as possible to uproot the six major malpractices of the police, including covering for their own." He added, "The six major malpractices can be seen as covering up cases involving their own, arbitrary case closures, evidence concealment and fabrication, leaks of investigative information, and infringement of personal information." (김 대표는 이날 “제 식구 감싸기 등 경찰의 6대 폐단을 뿌리 뽑을 수 있도록 여러가지 대책이 최대한 강구돼야 한다”고 했다. 그러면서“‘제 식구 감싸기’ 사건 암장, 무단 종결, 증거 은폐와 증거 조작, 수사 정보 유출, 개인정보 침해 등을 6대 폐단이라고 볼 수 있다”고 했다.)

He also said, "As ways to uproot all of these, various measures must be devised as much as possible, such as expanding external audits, strengthening grounds for investigation recusal, strengthening explanations and accountability to victims, strengthening legal liability for negligent investigations, and strengthening protection of personal information and privacy." (또 “이런 걸 다 뿌리 뽑을 수 있는 방법으로 외부 감사 확대, 수사 제척 사유 강화, 피해자에 대한 설명·책임 강화, 부실 수사에 대한 법적 책임 강화, 개인정보와 사생활 보호 강화 등 여러가지 대책이 최대한 강구돼야 한다”고 했다.)

Lawmaker Lee Hae-sik, co-head of the Police Reform Promotion Task Force, emphasized, "The demand for democratic control and reform of the police has become a routine task since democratization, but at this point when prosecution reform is being completed, it has become an inevitable and indispensable task of the times" and "The public's anger over the recent series of incidents involving the police, such as the Jang Yun-gi case and the deputy police chief case, shows the urgency and earnestness of police reform." (경찰개혁추진단 공동단장을 맡은 이해식 의원은 “경찰에 대한 민주적인 통제와 개혁의 요구는 민주화 이후에 일상적 과제가 됐으나 검찰개혁이 마무리되는 이 즈음에는 필연적이고 필수 불가결한 시대적 과제가 됐다”며 “최근 장윤기 사건, 부경장 사건 등 경찰을 둘러싸고 벌어졌던 일련의 사건에 대한 국민 분노는 경찰개혁에 대한 시급성과 절실성을 보여준다”고 강조했다.)

Lawmaker Kim Nam-hee, who serves as co-head alongside Lee, also said, "We will not start with a predetermined conclusion" and "President Lee Jae-myung has also emphasized the necessity and importance of police reform several times. We will create a system where the party and the government communicate and cooperate together, find solutions that can work on the ground, and push them forward." (이 의원과 함께 공동단장을 맡은 김남희 의원도 “결론을 정하고 출발하지 않겠다”며 “이재명 대통령도 경찰개혁 필요, 중요성을 여러 번 강조했다. 당정이 함께 소통하고 협력하는 체계를 만들어 현장에서 작동할 수 있는 해결책을 찾아 추진하겠다”고 말했다.)

After the meeting, Kim Nam-hee met with reporters and said, "Since discussions are also underway in the government, we will establish a governance structure for party-government consultations" and "We agreed to carry out necessary discussions through close communication with bodies such as the National Police Agency's Investigation Reform Committee and the police reform organization that the Prime Minister's Office has said it will launch." (김남희 의원은 회의를 마치고 취재진과 만나 “정부에서도 관련된 논의가 진행되고 있어서 당정 협의를 하는 거버넌스를 구축할 것”이라며 “경찰청 수사개혁위원회라든지, 총리실에서 출범하겠다고 한 경찰개혁 기구와 긴밀한 소통을 통해 필요한 논의를 해 나가자고 했다”고 전했다.)

item.title: Justice Minister Nominee Kim Seung-won Sends Text to Seo Young-kyo Explaining 'New Drug Lobbying Allegations'... "I Apologize" (법무장관 후보 김승원, 서영교에 ‘신약 청탁 의혹’ 해명 문자… “송구합니다”)
item.description:
Kim Seung-won, a lawmaker of the Democratic Party of Korea nominated as the Minister of Justice, was caught by press cameras on the 1st at the National Assembly plenary session sending a text message to Seo Young-kyo, chair of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, explaining the allegations of 'lobbying for approval of a COVID-19 clinical trial' for which he was previously investigated by prosecutors. After detailing the circumstances of the case and his own arguments, the nominee wrote, "I apologize." (법무부 장관 후보자로 지명된 김승원 더불어민주당 의원이 1일 국회 본회의장에서 서영교 국회 법제사법위원장에게 자신이 과거 검찰 수사를 받은 ‘코로나19 치료제 임상시험 승인 청탁 의혹’과 관련한 해명 문자메시지를 보내는 장면이 취재진 카메라에 포착됐다. 김 후보자는 사건 경위와 자신의 주장을 설명한 뒤 “송구합니다”라고 적었다.)

On the screen of Kim's phone captured by Kookmin Ilbo cameras that day was written: "Although 11 prosecutors were deployed for a three-year investigation, there was no direct evidence of a '5 million won promise,' no actual preferential treatment existed, and even the court related to the case denied any consideration for brokering, yet the prosecution left only Kim Seung-won with a suspended indictment—this is the core argument of the constitutional complaint." He then sent a summary of the relevant details to Chair Seo and added, "I apologize." (이날 국민일보 카메라에 포착된 김 후보자의 휴대전화 화면에는 “3년간 검사 11명을 투입해 수사했지만 ‘500만원 약속’의 직접증거도 없고, 실제 특혜도 없었으며, 관련 사건 법원마저 알선 대가성을 부정했는데 검찰은 김승원 의원에게만 기소유예 처분을 남겼다는 것이 헌법소원의 핵심 주장”이라는 내용이 적혀 있었다. 이어 서 위원장에게 관련 내용을 요약해 보낸 뒤 “송구합니다”라고 했다.)

The case Kim mentioned is a suspicion of lobbying surrounding the approval of a clinical trial for a COVID-19 treatment being developed by a company in 2021. Prosecutors investigated the process in which Professor Kang, the founder of the company, asked a broker named Yang to help obtain approval for the clinical trial from the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety, and Yang requested that Kim, then a lawmaker, ensure that the ministry's related work be expedited. Kim was suspected of having accepted Yang's request and asking the then-commissioner of the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety to allow the treatment to undergo clinical trials. (김 후보자가 언급한 사건은 2021년 한 업체가 개발하던 코로나19 치료제의 임상시험 승인을 둘러싼 로비 의혹이다. 검찰은 해당 업체 설립자인 강모 교수가 브로커 양모씨에게 식품의약품안전처의 임상시험 승인을 받을 수 있도록 도와달라고 부탁했고, 양씨가 당시 국회의원이던 김 후보자에게 식약처의 관련 업무가 신속히 처리되도록 해달라는 취지로 요청한 과정을 수사했다. 김 후보자는 양씨의 부탁을 받고 당시 식약처장에게 해당 치료제가 임상시험을 받을 수 있도록 해달라고 요청한 혐의를 받았다.)

During the investigation, circumstances were also confirmed in which Kang's side attempted to send approximately 5 million won to Kim's political donation account, and prosecutors investigated Kim for charges including bribery. In December 2024, the Seoul Western District Prosecutors' Office issued a suspended indictment for Kim's bribery charges. (수사 과정에서는 강씨 측이 김 후보자의 정치후원금 계좌로 약 500만원을 보내려 한 정황도 확인됐고, 검찰은 이를 포함해 김 후보자의 뇌물수수 등 혐의를 수사했다. 서울서부지검은 2024년 12월 김 후보자의 뇌물수수 혐의에 대해 기소유예 처분을 내렸다.)

A suspended indictment differs from a no-charge disposition. Under current prosecution case rules, a suspended indictment is defined as 'a case where the suspected facts are acknowledged, but it is determined that prosecution is not necessary in consideration of the motive and consequences of the crime and the circumstances of the suspect.' In other words, it is a non-prosecution disposition in which the prosecution acknowledges the suspected facts but does not bring the case to trial. (기소유예는 무혐의 처분과는 다르다. 현행 검찰사건사무규칙은 기소유예를 ‘피의사실이 인정되지만 범행 동기와 결과, 피의자의 사정 등을 참작해 소추할 필요가 없다고 판단하는 경우’로 규정하고 있다. 즉 검찰이 피의사실을 인정하면서도 재판에는 넘기지 않는 불기소 처분이다.)

At the time, Kim denied the allegations during the prosecution's investigation, stating that he had only relayed a related civil complaint and had not engaged in any improper lobbying. He later filed a constitutional complaint arguing that his suspended indictment was unjust, and the text sent to Chair Seo that day appears to contain these same arguments. (김 후보자는 당시 검찰 조사에서 관련 민원을 전달했을 뿐 부정한 로비를 한 것은 아니라는 취지로 혐의를 부인했다. 이후 자신의 기소유예 처분이 부당하다며 헌법소원을 제기했고, 이날 서 위원장에게 보낸 문자에도 이 같은 주장이 담긴 것으로 보인다.)

Earlier, independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon said at the National Assembly Special Committee on Budget and Accounts the previous day, "There is a fact that prosecutors investigated Kim for having received a request from an acquaintance to help grant approval for a COVID-19 new drug and then relaying that request to the commissioner of the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety." The text Kim sent to Chair Seo is understood to have been an attempt to explain the course of the investigation and his position regarding the allegations raised by Han. (앞서 한동훈 무소속 의원은 전날 국회 예산결산특별위원회에서 “김 후보자가 코로나 신약 치료제를 허가해 달라고 지인으로부터 청탁을 받아 식품의약품안전처장에게 청탁한 사실에 대해 검찰이 수사한 사실이 있다”고 했다. 김 후보자가 서 위원장에게 보낸 문자는 한 의원의 문제 제기 이후 관련 사건의 수사 경위와 자신의 입장을 설명하려 한 것으로 알려졌다.)

Regarding the text message, Kim's side said, "He explained to the chair of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee the facts concerning Han's claims." (김 후보자 측은 문자메시지에 대해 “한 의원의 주장에 대해 사실관계에 관한 내용을 법사위원장에게 설명한 것”이라고 했다.)
